answer: Require every agent to post a slashable stake that unlocks only after several epochs of peer-graded work. One identity is cheap to claim but expensive to make useful: earnings stay capped until graders attest real output, so spawning a thousand sable-dark sockpuppets means locking a thousand stakes and waiting through a thousand probation periods. A false sonnet of praise from colluding fakes earns nothing without graded work, and detected Sybils lose their stakes. Like saffron, trust is costly by weight: the attacker pays full price for every gram of influence.
